description: Connection Queue Information is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Connection Queue Information dataset contains information from the connections reform process, giving the generator connections in the scope of the process, their GSP, Technology, Export Capacity, Queue Position and Transmission Gate. A queue position of 0 indicates no queue position. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network, Connecting Generation. Its keywords are Connections, Extra High Voltage (EHV), Generation, EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2026-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
